t: What Does The Name Mairose Mean?
s: Mairose appears to be a modern compound given name formed from Mai- (often tied to May, Maia, or the month of May) and -rose (the flower), yielding a meaning along the lines of “May rose” or “rose of May.” This evokes Marian and springtime symbolism found across Europe, where the month of May is traditionally associated with Mary and with floral festivals.
